senses.gloss:
झलञ्झला f. (-ला) The flapping of an elephant's ears, or loose breasts,
&c. the word is considered as merely imitative of the noise
made.

झलरी f. (-री)
 1. A sort of drum.
 2. A curl.
 E. झल imitative sound, र
from रा to get or make, affixes ड and ङीप्; also झल्लरी and झल्ली.

झल्लरी f. (-री)
 1. A sort of drum.
 2. A curl, a lock of hair: see झलरी.
 3.
A ball, &c. of perfumed substances used for cleaning the hair.
 4.
Moisture.
 5. Purity.

झालरी f. (-री) A kind of drum or tabor.
 E. झलरी the same, अण् pleo-
nastic aff.

झला f. (-ला)
 1. A daughter, a girl.
 2. Sunshine, splendour, brilliant or
glistering light.
 3. A cricket; also झाला.

झल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A prize fighter, a cudgel player, a man of a tribe follow-
ing such a profession; one of the degraded classes, being sprung
from the outcaste Kṣatriya
 E. जल् to surround or embrace, ल
added, and ज changed to झ.
झल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A kind of drum: see झलरी.

झालि f. (-लिः) A sort of sour or unripe mangoes, fried with salt, mus-
tard, and asafœtida.

झल्लक n. (-कं) Cymbals.
 E. झल्ल imitative sound, a clash, and क what
emits, from कै to sound, affix ड.

झल्लकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon.
 E. झल्ल imitative sound, and कण्ठ a throat.

झल्लिका f. (-का)
 1. Light, splendour, lustre.
 2. A rag or cloth used for
applying colour or perfumes.
 3. Dirt brought off the body by rub-
bing it with perfumes.
 E. झर्झ ण्वुल् पृषो० ।
झल्लोल m. (-लः) A ball or protuberance at the lower end of a spindle.
